parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query start position.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. Up to 50 subkeys are supported. At least one of ResourceId and Tag must be provided. If both are empty, the API returns InvalidParameter.BothEmpty (400).

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The label list. Up to 20 subkeys are supported. At least one of ResourceId and Tag must be provided. If both are empty, the API returns InvalidParameter.BothEmpty (400).
